item.title: LOANED OUT | Paul Mullin heads to Bradford City
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm striker Paul Mullin has signed on loan for Bradford City until the end of the 2025/26 season. Back-to-back-to-back promotion winner Mullin, 31, started the season on loan with Wigan Athletic – scoring five goals. He returned to the Club in January, and will now spend the remainder of the season with Graham Alexander’s Bantams – who currently sit in the play-off places in League One. item.title: U18 REPORT | Oldham Athletic 1-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Tom Watkin's late headed goal secured Wrexham AFC Under-18s a valuable 1-1 draw away at Oldham Athletic. It was the hosts who found the breakthrough in the 72nd minute through a Solomon Butterfield header, but in the 90th minute, Craig Knight’s side rescued a well-deserved point as Watkin headed home a Tommy Clayton free kick. item.title: REPORT | Sheffield Wednesday 0-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Sam Smith’s sixth goal of the season proved the difference as Wrexham maintained their winning away form with victory at Hillsborough against Sheffield Wednesday. Smith slid in to break the deadlock in the second half – his fourth goal of a productive month for the striker. Wrexham largely controlled possession, but were grateful to an Arthur Okonkwo save and Matty James’ goal-line clearance to stay in front. item.title: GALLERY | Sheffield Wednesday 0-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC added a further three points to their tally as they beat Sheffield Wednesday on the road for a fourth straight away win. Josh Windass was among the starting 11 as he made his first return to Hillsborough since joining the Red Dragons last summer. After a goalless first half, Sam Smith proved the difference-maker on 58 minutes – tapping in from an Issa Kaboré cross.
